content.text: I found one additional broken invariant in the persistence layer: an old membership row is unique per workspace and user, but re-inviting a former member currently tries to insert a second row. I’m changing acceptance to restore that row, keep it active from the outset, and consume the invite only after validating the signed-in account and live workspace.

The main service changes are in place, and I’m tightening repository methods next. I’m preserving the existing API shapes while adding an explicit historical-member restoration path and making invitation listings include expired-but-unaccepted rows for re-send.

Removal now also clears only the removed person’s sessions that default to that workspace, selecting one of their remaining workspaces when possible. Workspace deletion clears that workspace from all sessions. I’m correcting seat-cache updates and invite re-send details, then I’ll stop after the edits as requested.
